changed_files.why: New, task-owned (section 5). The single selection helper the contract names: immutable ScopeContext (project_id, dataset_version_id, model_bundle_hash, deployment_allowlist, review_session_id, actor_id); the legacy dataset id derived from the verified ingestion-manifest SHA-256; and resolve_prediction_rows(conn, scope) -> list[SelectedPredictionRow], which intersects project, dataset, allowlist and model in SQL before any counting, ranking, paging or search, and raises PredictionSelectionIntegrityError on a duplicate (image_id, model_bundle_hash) instead of choosing a row.

Modified narrowly, task-owned (section 5). Gallery, detail, rank, search and export now all read from that one selection. This removes two measured defects: the gallery called _priority_rank_map(conn) with no project_id while the detail view passed one (gallery ranks counted other tenants' images), and model_bundle_hash appeared in no WHERE clause at all while the join was LEFT JOIN prediction ON image_id (a second bundle produced a second gallery card and an inflated total). Response field names are preserved; one field is ADDED (prediction_unavailable_reason) so an image with no prediction for the selected model reports null plus a reason instead of a zero score.

Modified narrowly, task-owned (section 5). The delegated reads now carry a server-resolved ScopeContext (scope_for) instead of a bare project_id, so the dataset version and the active deployment's model hash come from the server rather than the caller. The 404 messages and the 400 on a missing project are unchanged, so 'unknown image' and 'not in your project' stay indistinguishable.
New, task-owned (section 5). The named acceptance file for F003-AT01..AT05 plus the section 9 boundary/failure review, written first and observed failing for the intended missing behaviour.

limitations: MODE_PROJECT_ONLY is a real compatibility surface, not a formality. queries.* still accept the pre-F003 `project_id=` argument, which applies project + model + allowlist but NO dataset version. This is what the existing isolation regressions call, and it is deliberately narrower than the full contract rather than a silent widening: on the REAL corpus the difference is nil (the manifest's 1,144 ids are exactly the store's, measured), and it differs only for synthetic corpora outside the manifest. The server-side entry point scope_for_request, which the enterprise proxy uses, always declares a dataset version.

active_model_bundle_hash() returns the frozen G4 constant. There is no deployment registry in this prototype, so a genuine per-deployment model selection is E5's job (model:manage). One obvious limitation of that choice: if a second bundle were ever added to the real store, the default server-resolved scope would show only the frozen bundle's predictions, and selecting the other would need an explicit hash. That is the safe direction to fail, but it is a real constraint, not a solved problem.

Review state is adapted, not re-derived: the revision token stays image-global (because repo.submit_review compares against the image-global maximum) while the status uses only events referencing the selected prediction_id. Consequence: if the newest event on an image is on another model and an older event is on the selected one, the older event is used. That under-reports progress rather than over-reporting it, and get_image still returns the full append-only history.

The Step 06 integrity error is exercised against a store whose UNIQUE constraint was deliberately removed, because the shipped schema prevents duplicates. The code path is real and runs in production reads; the corruption it guards against has never been observed in this repository.

No browser/UI rehearsal and no screenshot: F003 changed no UI. The G6 frontend was not re-run because no frontend file changed; the additive `prediction_unavailable_reason` field is additive and no existing field was renamed or removed, but that is a code-reading claim, not a browser observation.
